description: Initialization of NLSRTL failed.
cause: An error condition was returned by lxzinit().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Initialization of NLS default callbacks failed.
cause: An error condition was returned by lxldini().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Initialization of NLS data loading failed.
cause: An error condition was returned by lxlinit().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: LSF string formatting package failed to load.
cause: An attempt was unsuccessfully made by lpmloadpkg() to load the lsf (library strings) package.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Initialization of LSFstring formatting package failed.
cause: An error condition was returned by lsfini().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Error accessing file %s .
cause: An error occurred when trying to access the file.
action: Verify that the file name is correct and that the file exists and is accessible.

description: Internal error .
cause: An error occurred when trying to execute an Oracle package.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: OCI call failed : %s
cause: An error occurred when making an OCI call.
action: Verify the cause of the failure using the log details and correct the error.

description: error occurred at: %s
cause: A GIM- error was generated.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Initialization of a context failed.
cause: See other messages on the error stack for the cause.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: OS-dependent operation:%s failed with status: %s
cause: An OS system call error was generated.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: OS failure message: %s
cause: An OS system call error was generated.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: OS failure occurred at: %s
cause: An OS system call error was generated.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Additional OS error information: %s
cause: An OS system call error was generated.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Initialization of SKGP context failed.
cause: An error condition was returned by skgpinit().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Could not allocate memory for instance context.
cause: An error condition was returned by lmmmalloc().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Invalid context passed to API function.
cause: The passed-in context either was not initialized or was corrupted.
action: Check your code to make sure that the context is initialized and there are no memory corruptions.

description: Initialization of shared memory region context failed.
cause: An error condition was returned by skgmsmr_op().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Health check failed to connect to instance.
cause: Health check was unable to attach to the shared memory region.
action: Restart the Oracle RDBMS instance. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Shared memory region is corrupted.
cause: Shared memory region was corrupted or inconsistent.
action: Restart the Oracle RDBMS instance. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Could not allocate memory for query context.
cause: An error condition was returned by lmmmalloc().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Failed to check if PMON is alive.
cause: An error condition was returned by skgpalive().
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: No instance state information in query context.
cause: An attempt was made to check for a particular condition in the Oracle instance state before getting instance state information.
action: Call gimh_get() before calling gimh_check() or gimh_next().

description: Value of state code %d is not in legal range.
cause: Illegal state code was passed to an API function.
action: Check that the parameter value passed in is valid.

description: State code %d is not supported.
cause: Detection of the specified state was not supported by the version of the Oracle RDBMS instance.
action: Change your program so that it does not check for this state on this instance.

description: Value of status code %d is not in legal range.
cause: Illegal status code was passed to an API function.
action: Check that the values passed as arguments are valid.

description: Query context with no parameters passed to a blocking call.
cause: No return condition was specified for this call.
action: Add a parameter to the query context to prevent this warning.

description: Condition (code: %d, status: %d) is already set.
cause: The specified condition was already set. There is no need to set it again.
action: This is a warning. No specific action is required, but you should consider if there is a reason to make this function call at all.

description: Condition (code: %d, status: %d) was not set before, but an attempt was made to reset it.
cause: The specified condition was not set. There is no need to reset it.
action: This is a warning. No specific action is required, but you should consider if there is a reason to make this function call at all.

description: No query parameters are set in the query context.
cause: An attempt was made to retrieve detected conditions from the query context with no query parameters set.
action: Set parameters in the query context before calling gimh_get().

description: Environment is not multithreaded.
cause: The operating system does not support multithreaded processes.
action: The end-to-end monitor works only in environments with support for multithreaded processes.

description: Cycle time has been reset to %s.
cause: The cycle time is recalculated based on the other parameters
action: No action required.

description: Invalid value for parameter %s.
cause: The value set for the parameter is invalid or is not in the allowed range.
action: Set the appropriate value for the parameter.

description: Number of retries more than maximum possible for connect string %s.
cause: The number of retries for connection established using the connect string has exceeded the maximum allowed.
action: Verify the cause of the failure using the log details and correct the error.

description: Invalid SQL statement ignored. SELECT not allowed in workload.
cause: Invalid SQL statement in the workload file. SELECT is not allowed in the workload.
action: Remove the invalid statement from the workload file.

description: The workload file has too many lines or too many SQL statements.
cause: Workload file has too many lines, or the number of SQL statemement in file may be larger than the maximum allowed. Only INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE are allowed.
action: Remove some SQL statements from the workload.

description: Thread creation for %s thread failed.
cause: The process thread to do the transaction could not be created.
action: Check the cause of the failure in the error logs.

description: Internal API error.
cause: The API library had an internal error.
action: Check the cause of the failure in the error logs. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Health check call failed : %s
cause: An error occurred when making an health check call.
action: Verify the cause of the failure using the log details and correct the error.

description: Workload file is too small or empty.
cause: Workload file is empty or SQL statement not terminated.
action: Check the Workload file and correct the error

description: Check for %s has been terminated.
cause: The transaction thread for the connect string has terminated. The end-to-end check will retry connection but will terminate completely after trying for max retries number of times.
action: Check the log file for error and correct it.

description: Error when initializing the log scanner.
cause: Initialization of the internal structures failed.
action: Report the error and other messages on the screen and in the log to Oracle Support Services.

description: Error when scanning the log for patterns .

action: The scanner process has failed and has stopped for all files. Check the error log for messages and restart the scanner.

description: Error when initializing internal packages .

action: Report the error to Oracle Support Services and try restarting.
